commit_message:
🧹 [Simplify deeply nested conditionals]

🎯 What: Simplified deeply nested conditionals in `_worker_loop` of `ShadowAnalyst/watcher.py`.
💡 Why: The nested structure reduced readability and maintainability. Inverting the condition allows for early exits and shallower nesting, improving code health.
✅ Verification: Ran pre-commit hooks and local test commands (python -m unittest discover). The tests completed with the same baseline results (failures unrelated to watcher.py).
✨ Result: The watcher logic remains identical in functionality but is cleaner and easier to read.
